name: PageHeader
description: The title block at the top of a page: breadcrumbs, then the title with its description and meta beside the actions, then tabs. Replaces Livewire's header.

livewire.name: page-header
capabilities: Slots: breadcrumbs, meta, actions and tabs; title and description also take slots

vue.name: PageHeader
capabilities: Slots: title, description, breadcrumbs, meta, actions and tabs

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the title, kept to the reading measure.

props.name: level
props.description: The title's heading level. The page's h1 by default; lower it when the header heads a section.
props.a11y: One h1 per page: the page header's title.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: Breadcrumbs above the title, usually a Breadcrumbs.

props.name: meta
props.description: Status above the title, such as a badge and an edited time.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons at the inline end of the title row, the primary one last. Keep to three; overflow into a DropdownMenu.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Tabs under the title row, usually Tabs with variant underline.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { title: '…', actions: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Stacks the breadcrumbs, the row and the tabs.

parts.name: row
parts.description: The title block and the actions, side by side; the actions wrap under the title when there's no room.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The title, at level (h1 by default), in the heading-xl type style.

parts.name: description
parts.description: Supporting text, muted, no wider than the reading measure.

parts.name: actions
parts.description: The buttons at the inline end of the row.

parts.name: tabs
parts.description: Holds the tabs under the row.

slots.name: title
slots.description: The title, when it needs markup.

slots.name: description
slots.description: The description, when it needs markup.

requirements: The title is the page's h1 unless level says otherwise; keep one h1 per page.
The description is plain text after the heading, so it's read in order.
Actions keep the order they're read in: the primary action last, at the inline end.
The row wraps rather than overflowing at 320px (reflow).

props.title: Dashboard
props.description: Income, profit and transactions across all stores.
